title: Propose the knowledge a closing feature earned, without blocking the close
action: Give bee close a SOFT promote door so finishing work proposes the knowledge it earned instead of accumulating it (per D2). On the green path only — after the tests door reports green and after the scribing-debt door passes — call crate::verbs::knowledge::build_promotion in process, exactly as close already calls build_close_report_doors at close.rs:541 and archive_feature_for_close at close.rs:774. Render the proposals to text and write them to docs/history/<feature>/promote-proposals.md, then append ONE headline line to close's output naming the counts and the file. Place the new line after the retirement match block that ends at close.rs:732 and before the final next: line at close.rs:734. fsutil.rs has no text writer — it exposes write_json_atomic at :138 and append_jsonl at :152 only — so add write_text_atomic beside them, following write_json_atomic's atomic temp-then-rename shape, and use it. THE DOOR IS SOFT: it never refuses close and never changes close's exit code. build_promotion returns Option<Promo>; its None arm means delegate to Node and rg -l buildContextManifest --glob '*.mjs' returns nothing, so there is no Node left — map BOTH None and Promo::Thrown to the same single warning line and continue. Nothing is written into docs/knowledge/ by this cell or by the door: D38 (promote proposes, it never writes, docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/context-and-promote.md:147) stays intact, and the proposals file lives under docs/history/, which no write guard forbids — docs_history_code_deny at hooks/write_guard/guards.rs:66-82 denies 22 code extensions and .md is not among them, plan_freeze_feature at hooks/write_guard/checks.rs:159-166 matches only plan.md, and the guard is a PreToolUse hook on agent tools, never on bee's own in-process writes.

truths: A green bee close emits one headline line naming the promote proposal counts and the written file
The file docs/history/<feature>/promote-proposals.md holds the delivery draft, the area updates and the pattern candidates
A promote Thrown leaves close's exit code unchanged and emits one warning line
A promote None leaves close's exit code unchanged and emits the same one warning line
A red tests door still refuses close before the promote door runs at all
key_links: close.rs writes the proposals through write_text_atomic
prohibitions: close's exit code never changes because of the promote door
No file under docs/knowledge/ is created, moved, or deleted
The tests door and the scribing-debt door keep their current refusal behaviour

trace.outcome: bee close soft-promotes on the green path, writing docs/history/<feature>/promote-proposals.md and adding write_text_atomic
